event.description:
Ready to enter the world of Grand Archive? Join us every Thursday evening at Koffie & Spel for a night of cards, strategy and fun!

Whether you're a seasoned player looking for new opponents, want to test a new deck, or are completely new to Grand Archive, everyone is welcome!
Bring your favourite deck, meet fellow players, learn the game and enjoy some casual matches.

💰 Free entry

Bring your deck and join the fun!
event.name: 🧙🏼‍♀️Grand Archive - Open Play📚
